messages:
anya: Quick poll: whos in for a "YAML open mic" tonight? Theme: dramatic indentation. :microphone:
matt: In. Ill do a spoken-word YAML: "key: feelings
  nested: regrets" very earnest. :sob: :laughing:
alex: Im bringing SemVer jokes. Lead with: "Why did the patch cross the road? To fix the backwards compatibility." :laughing:
riley: Ill do a compiler impression. Sound effect: *linker error intensifies*. :boom: :saxophone:
ops-bot: Kitchen closes at 7pm; event starts at 7:30pm. Calendar invite posted.
anya: Also prize for best joke: a sticker that says "I survived dependency hell". Highly coveted.
matt: Also rules: no merge-conflict interpretive dance. Were not emotionally ready. :grimacing:
alex: Can we have a side bet: whoever gets the most groans must bring coffee tomorrow? :coffee:
riley: Im competitive. I accept. :muscle:
ops-bot: Event created: "Indents & Bugs Open Mic"  invite sent to #random.
anya: Cool. BYO linting tool and good vibes. :sparkles:
